description: Rows each GPU and route must cover for full candidate acceptance or a development-only rehearsal, each GPU's limit and baseline files, and the frozen limit hashes and contract tag (qualification_protocol.md, E5 and E6). accept.py reads only this file for the required rows and the files it gates against; command-line flags cannot change them.

recipe.note: The acceptance recipe, the step 0 off recipe (qualification_protocol.md, E5). Every run is built by run_rows.build_command from its manifest row and the logged seeds, with `extra` (full runs: off, candidate, repeat, H3 extra seeds) or `tier1_extra` (tier 1 capture runs) appended; candidate runs then append the draw's candidate_args. `env` is the inference environment every run must have beyond its row's env (empty: LAYERNORM_TYPE and every OPENDDE_ variable unset); `host_env` names host-specific variables that are recorded but not compared. `diffusion_chunk_size` is the sampler chunk size every traced rollout must record.

port-chosen.note: Every sm_120 dispatch row is port-chosen (protocol, when a held-out draw is required).

dev-rehearsal.note: Development-only rehearsal of a candidate before any held-out draw (qualification_protocol.md, E5). The evidence names code_commit and candidate_args instead of a held-out draw; every check that does not need a draw runs, a declared freeze is required, and a pass exits 4, never 0. The rehearsed development runs become the development set of the final acceptance.

frozen.note: Frozen on 2026-10-12 by user approval as qual-sm120-contract-1, amended the same day as qual-sm120-contract-2 (dev-rehearsal route), qual-sm120-contract-3 (pre-draw rehearsal receipt, one draw per candidate, newest contract tag), qual-sm120-contract-4 (independent contract-version gate qual_gate.py, the receipt's contract tag) and qual-sm120-contract-5 (the gate's own remote as the tag source, the qual_gate.py --accept entrypoint, the receipt's gate record, model packages required to load from the acceptance checkout, unreadable measurement files reported as failed checks), amended on 2026-10-14 as qual-sm120-contract-6 (held-out seed range widened to 201-999; fail-closed run provenance: single-file no-search inputs, parser-read input digest with frozen effective digests for legacy-MSA inputs, before/after digests of referenced and template files, fresh template cache, runtime assets and Kalign checked against runtime_assets.json, actual seeds from the output layout; signature inventory and do-not-run audit); limit files and hashes unchanged; earlier tags superseded. The commit setting these values is tagged contract_tag and the tag is pushed. Run every rehearsal and acceptance through qual_gate.py --accept from a checkout of the approved tag, with PYTHONPATH set to the acceptance checkout; accept.py requires both hashes to match, the tag to be the newest of its family, and the draw's code commit to descend from it with scripts/qualification unchanged apart from the held-out log. Amended on 2026-10-18 as qual-sm120-contract-7 (one shared contract for sm_120 and sm_80: per-GPU limit and baseline files, sm_80's frozen limits and baseline, and the per-GPU D1 smoke test recorded in the rehearsal receipt); sm_120's limits, baseline and hashes unchanged. Changing anything under scripts/qualification needs a contract amendment and a new tag; no tag may be created while a draw is open.

port-chosen.note: Every sm_80 dispatch row is port-chosen (protocol, when a held-out draw is required).

dev-rehearsal.note: Development-only rehearsal of a candidate before any held-out draw (qualification_protocol.md, E5). The evidence names code_commit and candidate_args instead of a held-out draw; every check that does not need a draw runs, a declared freeze is required, and a pass exits 4, never 0. The rehearsed development runs become the development set of the final acceptance.

frozen.note: Frozen on 2026-10-18 by user approval as part of qual-sm120-contract-7, the shared contract of both GPUs: the sm_80 limits of porting_docs/sm80_limit_audit.md (tier 1 the sm_120 values; tier 2 the sm_120 values with the flexible-class same-outcome lDDT limit 0.92), calibrated on the replacement A100 (A100 80GB PCIe, driver 595.91.07), and baseline_off_sm80.json from that host's stock off (job 320). Run every rehearsal and acceptance through qual_gate.py --gpu sm_80 --accept from a checkout of the approved tag; a rehearsal receipt needs a passing D1 smoke test of sm_80 at that tag (smoke.py). Changing anything under scripts/qualification needs a contract amendment and a new tag; no tag may be created while a draw is open.
